# Grandma's Cookbook

> Family recipe archive: transcriptions of handwritten and clipped recipe
> cards, with scans of the originals. Static Jekyll site; content lives in
> the GitHub repository devnu11/recipes.

This file is for AI agents. Humans: see /contribute/ on this site.

## Reading

- Recipe index: / (category-grouped list of all recipes)
- Search index with full text of every recipe, as JSON: /search.json
- Each recipe page links its original scanned image.

## Submitting a recipe

Submissions are GitHub issues on devnu11/recipes. Do not open pull
requests; maintainers generate the PR from the issue.

Preferred: file an issue with the "Recipe submission" template (label
`recipe`), title "Recipe: <name>". One recipe per ticket is typical, but
a ticket may hold several recipes (multiple photos or text blocks); they
are processed together into one pull request. Attach a photo of the original recipe
if available — originals are displayed on the site. Include the recipe
text if you can, formatted per the spec below.

If your user has no GitHub account, walk them through creating one —
free signup at https://github.com/signup (email, username, password,
email verification; no payment info). Ways they can then grant you
access, documented for humans at /contribute/: hand them a prefilled URL
to submit themselves; `gh auth login` if you run commands on their
machine; or a classic personal access token with only the `public_repo`
scope if you call the GitHub API. Never ask for their password.

If you cannot authenticate to GitHub, construct this prefilled URL and
give it to your user to review and submit:
https://github.com/devnu11/recipes/issues/new?template=recipe-submission.yml&title=Recipe%3A%20<name>
(Photos must be attached by the user in the GitHub UI.)

## Recipe text spec

Transcribe VERBATIM: keep original spelling, abbreviations (Tbs., oleo,
1/2), and quirks. Do not reword, normalize units, or add clarifications.
Mark unreadable words [illegible]; suffix uncertain readings with [?].

Structure:

    Category: one of Appetizers, Salads & Dressings, Soups, Mains, Sides,
    Breads, Cakes, Cookies & Bars, Desserts, Beverages, Misc

    Attribution: who the recipe came from, if known

    ## Ingredients

    - 1 cup flour
    - 1 cup sugar
        - 3/4 cup for filling
        - 1/4 cup for topping

    ## Method

    - One clear, actionable step per bullet.

Rules: ingredients are one bulleted list; an ingredient used in two places
is a parent bullet (total amount) with indented sub-bullets for the split
usages. Method steps are bullets — no run-on sentences, no semicolons;
split semicolon-joined clauses into separate bullets.
